ad_info.structure_source: library format F64 (Aspirational lifestyle with a two-part phrase and the bottle) — structure np-08
ad_info.reference_style: Aspirational outdoor lifestyle supplement ad with a two-part statement, a CTA pill and the product on a rock
ad_info.angle_used: Identity / aspiration: not only the backside, also her legs and her confidence

global_identity.color_palette: Hot fuchsia #E6177F (accent word, divider line and CTA pill), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (main text), bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF. Secondary for this variation: clear morning sky blue #CFE4F2 and coffee-mountain green #4F7A45.
global_identity.visual_style: Bold, feminine real-photo lifestyle ad; ultra-realistic person like a real phone or editorial photo, the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Free, proud and sunny; a weekend morning outdoors, believable and warm.
global_identity.graphic_language: Clean text directly on the sky (no boxes), one thin fuchsia divider line, one rounded fuchsia CTA pill with a small circled arrow.
global_identity.text_typography: Main statement in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look); second part in Montserrat ExtraBold, sentence case; CTA in Poppins Bold.

creative_objective: Widen the desire for the mom who feels she lost her shape: not only the backside, also her legs and, above all, her confidence. Show it as a real, happy woman in jeans enjoying her day, with the bottle as the quiet signature.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) 'NO SOLO LA COLA.' 2) The happy woman on the right. 3) The second part of the phrase with 'seguridad' in fuchsia. 4) The CTA pill. 5) The bottle.
art_direction.composition_style: Text column on the upper left 55% over clear sky; the woman on the right 45% from head to knees, seated on a stone wall; the bottle in the lower left foreground on the same stone wall; landscape fills the bottom.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Left margin about 6%; the first line, the divider, the second part and the CTA pill stacked with even gaps; the bottle stands below the pill, never touching the text.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft side morning sunlight from the left, clear sky, distant hazy green mountains for depth, shallow depth of field on the far landscape only.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Upper left: a short impact phrase in big heavy type with a thin colored line under it. Below it: the second part of the phrase in 3-4 lines with one word in the accent color, then a rounded CTA pill with a circled arrow. Lower left: the bottle standing on a rock. Right half: a smiling woman seated on a rock in an outdoor mountain viewpoint, looking into the distance. Bottom: landscape and rock.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Impact phrase that breaks the expectation
Widens the desire, accent word in color
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: 'También tus piernas y tu seguridad' with 'seguridad' in fuchsia
Fuchsia pill 'Empieza tu plan de 3 meses' with a white circled arrow
The real closed bottle standing on the stone wall
Colombian mom of about 38 in jeans, smiling, facing the camera, seated on the wall
Colombian coffee-region green mountains under a clear sky

detected_visual_blocks.block_type: user trust seal (required by the user)
detected_visual_blocks.position: small line at the bottom left, on the stone under the bottle
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Registration seal the user asked for
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Exact text, small, white with a soft dark shadow

forbidden_additions: Benefit lists, icons, price, offer boxes, stars or testimonials
Loose capsules or an open bottle
Poses from behind or body-focused close-ups

visual_prompt:
Square 1:1 ultra-realistic outdoor lifestyle photo ad, like a real editorial photo taken on a sunny weekend morning at a viewpoint in the Colombian coffee region: clear pale sky #CFE4F2 in the upper half, layered hazy green mountains #4F7A45 in the distance, and a rough grey stone wall in the foreground across the bottom 30%. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the bottle: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it; ignore the hand and the counter in that photo. If a layout reference image is attached, use it ONLY for the position of the blocks; never copy its text, brand, bottle, person or colors.

UPPER LEFT (0-25% of height, left 58% of width), directly on the sky with no box: 'NO SOLO LA COLA.' in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), dark plum #2B1226, uppercase, one line, about 55% of the width. Under it a thin hot fuchsia #E6177F line about one third of the width.

LEFT COLUMN (25-60%): the second part in Montserrat ExtraBold, sentence case, dark plum #2B1226, three lines: 'También tus piernas' / 'y tu' / 'seguridad', where the word 'seguridad' is hot fuchsia #E6177F. Under it a rounded hot fuchsia #E6177F pill with white Poppins Bold text 'Empieza tu plan de 3 meses' and a small white circle with a right arrow at its right end.

RIGHT 45% (from the top margin down to the stone wall): an adult Colombian woman of about 38, warm tan skin with real texture, visible pores, a few freckles and fine smile lines, natural brows, no studio makeup, long dark-brown wavy hair loose with flyaway strands moving in the breeze. She sits on the stone wall facing the camera at three-quarters, body turned slightly to the left, laughing naturally and looking just past the camera, one hand resting on her knee, the other on the stone. She wears a white linen button shirt with rolled sleeves and real wrinkles, tucked into high-waisted mid-blue jeans that fit her hips and thighs snugly and look natural, a thin brown belt and white sneakers; she is framed from the top of her head to just below the knees, never from behind. Soft side morning sunlight from the left, natural shadows, real phone-photo look, no plastic skin.

LOWER LEFT (60-92%), on the stone wall in the foreground: ONE closed real bottle standing upright, about 30% of the canvas height (about as tall as her forearm in the photo, because it is closer to the camera), label facing the camera, fully legible and never mirrored: a matte black cylinder about 1.6 times taller than wide with straight sides and no neck, a wide glossy hot-pink cap almost as wide as the body with a small white 'VITALABH' pattern, a hot-pink band on the bottom fifth, black label with the huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1', the pink banner, the italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' and the three pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE + 400mg FENOGRECO + 200mg MACA NEGRA'. Same sunlight from the left, a natural contact shadow on the stone; matte, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare.

BOTTOM (92-100%): the stone wall, and under the bottle a small line of white Poppins SemiBold text with a soft dark shadow: 'AGREGAR LOGO Y SELLO DE REGISTRO INVIMA RSA-0030271-2024', fully legible.

mandatory_visual_elements: Ultra-realistic Colombian woman of about 38 in jeans, smiling, facing the camera, seated on a stone wall on the right half
Coffee-region green mountains under a clear morning sky
Thin hot fuchsia divider line under the first line
Hot fuchsia CTA pill with a white circled arrow
One closed real bottle standing on the stone wall in the lower left, label legible
final_generation_exclusions: No loose capsules, no pills, no open bottle; the woman holds nothing.
No pose from behind, no body close-ups.
No benefit icons, stars, prices or testimonials.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts. The phrase speaks of desire and confidence, not of a defect.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia).
